 Inter Shakhtar Donetsk Champions League Inter vs Shakhtar Donetsk Follow Inter v Shakhtar Donetsk, a match on matchday three of the Champions League league phase
 Inter return to Champions League action on matchday three of the 2026/2027 league phase when they host Shakhtar Donetsk. The 9pm kick-off at San Siro is already a do-or-die game for Cristian Chivu's side. After defeats to Real Madrid and Bruges, Inter must respond to keep their hopes of a top-eight place alive. Arda Turan's players arrive in a more comfortable position with 4 points from their first two outings. 
 Inter-Shakhtar 0-0 
 SCORERS: - 
 Goals and highlights
 69' Bastoni sent off - Bastoni picks up two yellow cards in just three minutes, leaving Inter with 10 men. He gets the first for protesting to the fourth official. At a corner marked by plenty of provocation, he pushes Ocheretko in the face with his hands. Ocheretko makes the most of the shove, convincing the referee to show a second yellow. 
 66' Chance - A miraculous save from Riznyk keeps Shakhtar in it. Thuram picks up the ball out wide on the left, cuts inside Marlon onto his right foot and curls a slightly deflected shot towards the far corner. Riznyk flies across to turn it behind for a corner. 
 60' Chance - The substitutes make an immediate impact. Diouf and Bisseck exchange passes on the move before Bisseck's run is stopped at the last moment in the area. The ball then reaches Bonny, who cuts inside onto his right foot and shoots, but Riznyk saves. 
 55' Yellow card - Alisson tries a Neymar-style trick, lifting the ball over Dimarco's head before surging forward. Thuram brings him down with a heavy challenge. Players crowd around to protest, and the referee books the Frenchman. 
 40' Chance - Inter survive! At a corner from the right, Barella loses Bondar, who outjumps him and heads towards the corner of the goal. Josep Martinez flies across and palms the ball away. 
 21' Chance - Another superb save from Riznyk, this time to deny Bonny's shot on the turn from the edge of the area. The ball bounces around in the box, but Matvienko gets to it just before Bonny. 
 19' Inter protest - From a corner on the right, Akanji rises to head the ball back across goal and it strikes Marlon's bent arm. The ball stays loose and Bonny, after a touch from Barella, shoots over. Prime's replay analyst Calvarese says: "The arm is bent and it is not punishable." 
 7' - Inter are caught out this time as Pedrinho carries the ball 30 metres and tries a left-footed shot from the edge of the area. A deflection takes the sting out of it, and Josep Martinez saves easily. 
 5' Chance - Inter win the ball back again and Calhanoglu shoots from the edge of the area. His effort goes wide. 
 3' Chance - Sucic wins the ball and finds Bonny in the area. Bonny sets up Thuram, whose right-footed shot across goal is saved by Riznyk. 
 0' Kick-off at the Giuseppe Meazza in San Siro at 9pm.

 Inter-Shakhtar 0-0 
 Scorers: None 
 Inter (3-5-2): Josep Martínez; Akanji, Bastoni, Carlos Augusto; Spence (59' Diouf), Barella, Calhanoglu (59' Zielinski), Sucic, Dimarco (59' Bisseck); Bonny, Thuram. 
 Substitutes: Di Gennaro, Provedel, Stankovic, Luis Henrique, Mkhitaryan, Stante, Bovio, Mosconi, Pio Esposito. 
 Manager: Chivu.

 Substitutes: Fesiun, Traore, Kryskiv, Newerton, Isaque, Ghram, Karavaiev, Gabriel Carvalho, Nazaryna, Lucas Ferreira, Luca Meirelles, Bruninho. 
 Manager: Arda Turan. 
 Referee: Osmers (GER) 
 Booked: Ocheretko (S), Thuram (I), Marlon (S), Sucic (I) 
 Sent off: Bastoni (I) for a second yellow card
